welcome_desc: Let us show you around your new command center.
step_dashboard: This is your main dashboard. Real-time metrics at a glance.
step_modules: Access all your business modules here.
sidebar_search_desc: Instantly search and navigate to any module, app, or setting within the sidebar.
overview_desc: Your command center. View core metrics, system health, and recent activities at a glance.
security_desc: Manage operator access, define role-based permissions, and enforce security policies.
tenants_desc: Provision and monitor independent tenant environments and database nodes.
landing_templates_desc: Design and configure the public-facing landing page for your ecosystem.
modules_group_desc: Access dedicated management modules like Inventory, Finance, and Human Resources.
inventory_desc: A centralized system for tracking assets, low-stock alerts, and supply chains.
nightclub_desc: Specialized module for venue management, table reservations, and staff assignments.
apps_group_desc: Utility applications designed to enhance productivity and system interoperability.
converter_desc: Easily convert files format, transform data structures, and handle encodings.
mail_desc: End-to-end encrypted messaging system for internal operator communication.
storage_desc: Secure, scalable object storage for documents, media, and system backups.
api_docs_desc: Interactive developer documentation and integration guides for the HIVE.OS API.
settings_desc: Fine-tune core system parameters, ecosystem branding, and global rules.
topbar_search_desc: Quickly find users, nodes, or settings across the entire ecosystem.
topbar_lang_desc: Switch system language instantly. Translations are pulled directly from the matrix.
topbar_theme_desc: Toggle between light, dark, or system-default visual modes.
topbar_fullscreen_desc: Expand the dashboard to fill your entire screen for maximum focus.
topbar_notif_desc: Review critical security alerts, system updates, and node status changes here.
topbar_profile_desc: Access your personal settings, view your active clearance level, or log out of the node securely.
node_mgmt_desc: This is the command hub for all tenant nodes on the system.
provision_desc: Click here to allocate new infrastructure for a tenant.
matrix_search_desc: Filter nodes by ID or name instantly.
copy_desc: Copy the current matrix view for sharing or documentation.
export_desc: Download the entire dataset in CSV or Excel format.
print_desc: Generate a physical or PDF report of the active nodes.
refresh_desc: Update the table to pull the latest telemetry from the network.
matrix_desc: Monitor the live pulse of the network infrastructure.
inspect_desc: View deep-level telemetry and contact details for this specific node.
power_desc: Immediately suspend or restore connectivity for this node.
clearance_desc: Enable or disable Super Admin entry protocols for this tenant.
reconfig_desc: Update organization name, capability plan, or routing domain.
purge_desc: Permanently delete the node and its associated data vault. Use with caution.
audit_desc: This immutable ledger records every action taken within the network.
ledger_desc: Switch between live active logs and cold storage vaults.
scope_desc: Filter logs originating from central control or specific tenant nodes.
time_desc: Select specific dates or ranges to isolate events.
vault_desc: Configure retention policies or trigger manual cold storage syncs.
deep_search_desc: Locate specific audit entries by operator name, description, or module.
forensic_desc: Inspect the exact data payload and metadata transmitted during an event.
tabs_nav_desc: Switch between system operators, access roles, and network permissions here.
users_header_desc: Manage all human and machine identities operating within this node.
users_provision_desc: Create a new operator identity and assign an initial clearance level.
users_search_desc: Locate operators by name or email address instantly.
users_export_desc: Securely download the master operator list.
users_view_desc: Review deep-level metadata and history for this operator.
users_status_desc: Immediately lock or unlock an operator's network connectivity.
users_edit_desc: Modify clearance levels, encryption keys, or profile details.
users_purge_desc: Permanently revoke access and destroy the identity associated with this node.
roles_tab_desc: System has automatically pivoted to the Access Roles matrix.
roles_header_desc: Define what operators can and cannot do within the environment.
roles_provision_desc: Create a new role and bind specific network capabilities to it.
roles_search_desc: Locate specific clearance levels by designation.
roles_copy_desc: Copy the role configuration to your clipboard.
roles_export_desc: Securely download the clearance level matrix.
roles_print_desc: Generate a printable report of all active roles.
roles_refresh_desc: Pull the latest capability index from the network.
roles_view_desc: Review the exact capabilities bound to this clearance level.
roles_edit_desc: Add or remove explicit capabilities from this role.
roles_purge_desc: Permanently destroy this clearance level. Use with extreme caution.
perms_tab_desc: Finally, the system has exposed the global Capability Dictionary.
perms_header_desc: Review all possible operations a user can perform across the system.
